caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, tapestry space, patterned clouds, a seated sacred figure in red robes on a lotus throne amid swirling blue clouds, small attendant figures below, dark mountains behind, azurite blue, malachite green, cinnabar red, ochre, jade white
notes_zh: 敦煌系观音坐像：红袍结跏坐，云气漩涡环绕，下有小供养人，石青石绿斑驳。
